residual: The issue's suggested fix #1 was NOT implemented: coverage-report's `cards` array is still HashMap-ordered at v0.82.0 (analyze_coverage iterates CardDatabase::face_iter, no sort; face_iter doc: 'walks a HashMap and so yields a different order per process'), and gap_bundles still sorts by unlocked_cards with no tiebreak. The comparator no longer depends on input order, so this no longer produces spurious oracle_changed, but coverage-data.json remains not digest-comparable run-to-run.
result: The reported outcome does not reproduce on v0.82.0: permuted-but-identical coverage rows (including a lowercased-name collision with distinct oracle texts) diff to oracle_changed=0 with every row compared; a genuine parse change planted on a duplicate-name row is detected. The pre-fix code (86ed39cc~1) reproduces both reported harms on the same fixture (spurious oracle_changed=1; planted change invisible). The defect was fixed by commit 86ed39cc (PR #7118, 2026-08-09), three days after the issue was filed.
